name: pet.singing/singing-pet
title: Singing Pet
description: Make a pet sing or dance: singing videos, dances, effects and custom pet songs from one photo.

tools.name: list_song_templates
tools.description: List the songs a pet can be animated singing. Call this before create_singing_video to get a valid template_id. Returns the id, song name and artist for each.

tools.name: list_moves
tools.description: List the dances and effects a pet photo can be turned into, instead of a singing video. Dances (kind dance) make the pet dance to a song: trending dances, legendary ones and fun moves. Effects (kind effect) make something happen to the pet, with sound the video model makes itself. Call this before create_move_video to get a valid move slug; each move's template_id field says whether it needs a song from list_song_templates (required), may take one in place of its own (optional), or takes none (not_allowed).

kind.description: Only dances (the pet dances to a song) or only effects (something happens to the pet, with its own sound). Both when left out.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: How many API credits are left. One credit renders one video. Check this before creating a video if you want to fail early rather than on a 402.

tools.name: create_singing_video
tools.description: Animate a pet photo so the pet appears to sing a song, with the mouth synced to the audio. Takes a public URL to a photo (one pet, facing the camera, well lit works best) and a template_id from list_song_templates. Costs 1 credit. Rendering takes about a minute, so this returns immediately with a video id - poll get_video_status until it is completed.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL to a photo of the pet. JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 15MB.

tools.name: create_move_video
tools.description: Turn a pet photo into a short video of the pet doing a move from list_moves: dancing to a song (a dance), or something happening to it with its own sound (an effect). Use it when someone wants their own pet dancing, or in a fun effect, rather than singing. Takes a photo (image_url, or the attached photo; the pet clearly visible, well lit) and a move slug. For a dance whose template_id is required, also send a song from list_song_templates; never send one with an effect. Every pet in the photo takes part. Costs 1 credit. It returns at once with a video id: poll get_video_status about every 10 seconds until it is completed (usually about a minute).

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL to a photo of the pet. JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 15MB. Send this or photo.

photo.description: A photo the person attached in the chat. ChatGPT fills this in; other clients send image_url.

move.description: The slug of a dance or effect, from list_moves.

template_id.description: Dances only: the song to dance to, from list_song_templates. Required when the move's template_id is required, optional when the dance has its own song (it replaces it), refused for effects.

tools.name: delete_video
tools.description: Permanently delete one of this account's videos. Does not refund the credit it cost.

tools.name: get_video_status
tools.description: Check whether a video has finished rendering. Status is pending, processing, completed or failed. When completed, video_url is a direct MP4 link. Poll roughly every 10 seconds; a render takes about a minute.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List this account's videos, newest first, with their status and download URLs.

limit.description: How many to return. Defaults to 25.

tools.name: create_pet_song
tools.description: Write and record a custom song about a pet from one photo, and make an HD video of the pet singing it. Use it when someone wants a personalised song or singing video of their own pet, for themselves or as a gift (birthday, Christmas, Mother's Day, gotcha day...). Needs a photo (image_url, or the attached photo), the pet's name, species and the occasion; ask for anything missing rather than inventing it. Nothing is made until it is paid for: the person pays at checkout_url, then the lyrics, the song and the HD video are made in about five minutes. Returns at once with the song id, status draft and the checkout link.

image_url.description: Public URL to a photo of the pet: one pet, facing the camera, well lit. JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 15MB. Send this or photo.

photo.description: A photo the person attached in the chat. ChatGPT fills this in; other clients send image_url.

pet_name.description: The pet's name, as it should be sung.

species.description: What the pet is: dog, cat, rabbit, parrot...

recipient_name.description: Who the song is for, if it is a gift for someone else. Their first name is sung.

relationship.description: Who the recipient is to the person buying it. 'myself' when it is for them.

details.description: Quirks, nicknames, favourite toys or habits, up to 300 characters. They make the lyrics personal.

voice.description: The singing voice. Defaults to female.

language.description: Language the song is sung in. Defaults to the conversation's language, else English.

tier.description: standard (768p) or deluxe (1080p). Only changes the paid HD video and its price or credit cost.

payment.description: checkout (default): the person pays at a checkout link first, then the song and the HD video are made. credits: spend this account's API credits (4 for a standard song, 6 for deluxe) and render the HD video straight after the preview with no checkout. Only for developers who have bought credits; refused otherwise.

tools.name: get_pet_song
tools.description: The state of a song made with create_pet_song: its status, the checkout link until it is paid, the lyrics, and the HD video and gift page once paid and made. Poll it about every 30 seconds while the status is draft (waiting for payment), paid or rendering. Follow next_step.
